metadata.method: GitHub search API: 10 thematic queries + 24 repo:owner/name detail lookups + 6 in:name recovery probes; raw payloads persisted in artifacts/oss-fvm/raw/; unique candidate pool 420 repos; curated 34 repos after quality filter (no forks, substantive code, FVM/FV-adjacent).
selection_criteria: tier1: complete production FV/DG solver with flux-scheme library, order-control, AMR or hybrid DG path
tier2: differentiable / generic PDE framework family
tier3: specialised capability layer (adjoint, ROM, physics add-on, tooling)

tier_legend.1: 完整求解器 (flux schemes / order / AMR / hybrid DG)
tier_legend.2: 可微/框架族 (differentiable or generic PDE framework)
tier_legend.3: 专项能力 (adjoint, ROM, niche physics, tooling)

repositories.api_description: OpenFOAM Foundation development repository
repositories.summary: Foundation development line of OpenFOAM: cell-centred FVM on arbitrary polyhedral meshes with a pluggable flux/limiter library (upwind..linearUpwind, limited schemes), dynamicRefineFvMesh AMR, VOF/Lagrangian multiphase, MPI domain decomposition. Reference implementation for the whole OpenFOAM family and the de-facto engineering baseline for ship hydrodynamics cases.

repositories.api_description: SU2: An Open-Source Suite for Multiphysics Simulation and Design
repositories.summary: SU2 multiphysics suite: unstructured compressible FV solver (Roe/AUSM/HLLC family Riemann solvers, MUSCL limiters) with an available high-order DG/FEM path in the same code base, discrete+continuous adjoint for shape optimisation, MPI. Closest single OSS reference for a FV<->DG hybrid interface.

repositories.api_description: 🌊  Julia software for fast, friendly, flexible, ocean-flavored fluid dynamics on CPUs and GPUs
repositories.summary: Oceananigans.jl: incompressible Boussinesq FV on staggered grids in Julia, runs the same code on CPU and GPU; production ocean modelling (CliMA) with documented LES/validation cases - the most active GPU-FV reference outside the OpenFOAM ecosystem.

repositories.api_description: Fast and simple fluid simulator in Julia
repositories.summary: WaterLily.jl: fast incompressible FV solver with immersed-boundary geometry and GPU execution in Julia; designed so the whole time step is differentiable (Enzyme AD), giving a minimal, readable FV kernel suitable as a verification/differentiation test bed.

repositories.api_description: PyFR
repositories.summary: PyFR: high-order flux-reconstruction / DG solver for advection-diffusion systems on mixed unstructured meshes with pluggable GPU back-ends (CUDA/OpenCL/HIP) and MPI; the reference OSS demonstration that high-order accuracy and GPU throughput coexist.

repositories.api_description: Finite volume solver for incompressible multiphase flows with surface tension. Foaming flows in complex geometries.
repositories.summary: Aphros: FV solver for incompressible multiphase flows with surface tension (foaming flows in complex geometry), block-structured AMR and MPI; VOF/level-set style interface handling with published Taylor-Couette / foam validation.

repositories.api_description: code_saturne public mirror
repositories.summary: EDF code_saturne: collocated FVM on hybrid/polyhedral meshes with co-located velocity-pressure coupling, RANS/LES turbulence, Lagrangian multiphase (coal/pulverised fuel), mesh refinement and MPI parallelism; strong industrial-verification culture (EDF QA + validation test-suite).

repositories.api_description: Package for solving hyperbolic systems of partial differential equations
repositories.summary: Clawpack: high-resolution Godunov-type FV solvers for hyperbolic systems (Riemann solvers + wave propagation limiters), with AMRClaw (Berger-Colella AMR), GeoClaw shallow-water and a published verification suite; Python driver around Fortran kernels.

repositories.api_description: ExaDG - High-Order Discontinuous Galerkin for the Exa-Scale
repositories.summary: ExaDG: matrix-free high-order DG for incompressible/compressible flow, convection-diffusion and structure, built on deal.II; geometric+algebraic multigrid preconditioners targeted at exascale MPI runs.

repositories.api_description: HORSES3D: A high-order discontinuous Galerkin solver for flow simulations and multi-physics applications
repositories.summary: HORSES3D: high-order DG solver for compressible flow and multi-physics (Fortran, MPI); includes curved-element handling and shock-capturing strategies for high-order FV/DG comparisons.

repositories.api_description: A parallel, adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) code that solves the variable-density incompressible Navier-Stokes equations.
repositories.summary: IAMR (incflo): variable-density incompressible Navier-Stokes solver on the AMReX block-structured AMR framework (Berger-Colella), projection method with GPU offload; the canonical example of a production FV solver whose AMR machinery is a reusable library.

repositories.api_description: Unofficial mirror of git://git.code.sf.net/p/foam-extend/foam-extend-4.0
repositories.summary: foam-extend 4.0 (community OpenFOAM fork, unofficial GitHub mirror): block-coupled solvers, immersed-boundary, VOF multiphase and extended fvSchemes library. Metadata shows the mirror is frozen since 2022 - capability reference only, not a live upstream.

repositories.api_description: A differentiable PDE solving framework for machine learning
repositories.summary: ΦFlow: differentiable PDE solving framework with multiple advection schemes (semi-Lagrangian, Mac Cormack, BFECC), mesh and particle domains, and interchangeable TensorFlow/PyTorch/JAX/Taichi back-ends - the most widely used differentiable-FV stack.

repositories.api_description: Computational Fluid Dynamics in JAX
repositories.summary: jax-cfd: CFD research framework in JAX - incompressible FV/spectral solvers written as JIT-compiled, end-to-end differentiable programs; reference for autodiff-compatible FV operators.

repositories.api_description: AMReX: Software Framework for Block Structured AMR
repositories.summary: AMReX: C++ framework providing block-structured AMR, mesh data, FV primitives, MPI+GPU parallelism and linear solvers, used by IAMR/PeleC/Nyx. Framework (not solver) - the reference design for AMR infrastructure a TensorFVM-style code would have to match.

repositories.api_description: Differentiable Fluid Dynamics Package
repositories.summary: JAX-Fluids: fully differentiable compressible FV solver in JAX with WENO reconstruction, HLLC/Riemann fluxes, level-set multiphase and immersed boundaries; closest OSS analogue of a differentiable high-order compressible FV core.

repositories.api_description: FiPy is a Finite Volume PDE solver written in Python
repositories.summary: FiPy: Python finite-volume PDE framework (cell-centred FV on structured/unstructured meshes) with implicit multiphysics coupling; the generic 'assembly + solve' reference for FV discretisation APIs, not a flow solver.

repositories.api_description: AeroJAX: A differentiable, structure-preserving framework for real-time flow simulation, control, and inverse design. Architected for neural operator integration and latent-space acceleration. Built w
repositories.summary: AeroJAX: differentiable, structure-preserving aero framework for real-time flow simulation, control and inverse design; small-footprint example of AD-through-solver for aerodynamic design loops.

repositories.api_description: RapidCFD is an OpenFOAM fork running fully on CUDA platform. Brought to you by
repositories.summary: RapidCFD: OpenFOAM fork with a fully CUDA sparse linear-solver / matrix path, i.e. an existing attempt to port a mature FVM stack to GPU; evidence of where GPU offload pays off in FV codes.

repositories.api_description: DAFoam: Discrete Adjoint with OpenFOAM for High-fidelity Multidisciplinary Design Optimization
repositories.summary: DAFoam: discrete adjoint + MDO layer on OpenFOAM giving analytic derivatives of CFD objectives (high-fidelity aerodynamic shape optimisation); reference for adjoint-based gradient verification.

repositories.api_description: Foam-Agent: A large language model-based multi-agent framework for automating computational fluid dynamics workflows. Published in Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering (CMAME).
repositories.summary: Foam-Agent: LLM-based multi-agent framework automating CFD workflows on OpenFOAM (case setup, run, debug); evidence that case orchestration is emerging as a first-class engineering layer.

repositories.api_description: A CFD solver for multi-component compressible flow with application to high-explosive detonation, explosive safety and air blast
repositories.summary: blastfoam: OpenFOAM-based multi-component compressible solver for detonation/blast and shock physics (explosive safety); reference for stiff compressible verification (Sod, Woodward-Colella).

repositories.api_description: Hypersonic / Rarefied gas dynamics code developments (GPL-3.0)
repositories.summary: hyStrath: hypersonic / rarefied-gas extensions for OpenFOAM (thermochemical non-equilibrium, DSMC-like modules); niche-physics reference for high-Mach compressible FV.

repositories.api_description: Python classes for easier creation of OpenFOAM's blockMesh dictionaries.
repositories.summary: classy_blocks: Python classes generating OpenFOAM blockMesh dictionaries (parametric hex meshing); reference for scriptable geometry->mesh pipelines.

repositories.api_description: ✨ A modern Python package for interacting with OpenFOAM
repositories.summary: foamlib: modern Python package for interacting with OpenFOAM (case setup, execution, field I/O); reference for a Pythonic driver API over a C++ FVM solver.

repositories.api_description: Reduced order modelling techniques for OpenFOAM
repositories.summary: ITHACA-FV: reduced-order modelling toolbox for OpenFOAM (POD/POD-DEIM Galerkin ROMs) with error/energy metrics; reference for ROM-based acceleration of FV campaigns.

repositories.api_description: Toolbox to simulate GNF and viscoelastic fluid flows in OpenFOAM®
repositories.summary: rheoTool: OpenFOAM toolbox for generalised Newtonian and viscoelastic flows (constitutive-model library + stabilised discretisation); reference for complex-rheology FV verification.

repositories.api_description: Immersed boundary method empowered by signed distance field, and OpenFOAM.
repositories.summary: sdfibm: immersed-boundary method driven by signed-distance-field geometry on OpenFOAM, for moving/complex bodies; reference for cut-cell/IBM alternative to body-fitted meshing.

repositories.api_description: libAcoustics - OpenFOAM library for far-field noise computation
repositories.summary: libAcoustics: OpenFOAM library for far-field noise computation (Ffowcs Williams-Hawkings analogy); reference for coupled CFD->acoustics post-processing validation.

repositories.api_description: flowTorch - a Python library for analysis and reduced-order modeling of fluid flows
repositories.summary: flowTorch: Python library for analysis and reduced-order modelling of fluid flows (POD/DMD/manifold learning) with OpenFOAM readers; reference for post-processing and ROM tooling.

repositories.api_description: In-situ data analyses and machine learning with OpenFOAM and Python
repositories.summary: PythonFOAM: in-situ data analysis and machine learning coupled to OpenFOAM through Python (shared-memory coupling); reference for solver<->Python data exchange without file I/O.

repositories.api_description: OpenFOAM-preCICE adapter
repositories.summary: openfoam-adapter: preCICE coupling adapter for OpenFOAM enabling partitioned FSI/conjugate heat transfer with other solvers; reference for solver-agnostic coupling interfaces.

repositories.api_description: A porous multiphase toolbox for OpenFOAM
repositories.summary: porousMultiphaseFoam: porous-media multiphase toolbox for OpenFOAM (Darcy/Richards/IMPCES solvers); reference for porous/ice-mushy analogue modelling.

repositories.api_description: Actuator line modeling for OpenFOAM.
repositories.summary: turbinesFoam: actuator-line/actuator-disk models for wind/marine turbines inside OpenFOAM; reference for body-force propulsion-representation modelling (propeller/rudder analogues).

gaps.need: TensorFVM 缺统一的解析解/基准回归面（Sod 激波管、Ghia 顶盖驱动、Taylor-Green 涡、Martin-Moyce 溃坝、channel-flow log-law），无法把格式改动与精度退化绑定。
gaps.proposal: 建立 benchmarks/ 目录 + 每算例 YAML（网格/CFL/格式/参考值/容差），CI 上跑 1D/2D 小网格，回归判据用 L1/L2 相对误差阈值（<3%）与收敛阶斜率（实测阶 vs 理论阶 ±0.2）。
gaps.acceptance: ≥5 个算例入 CI，实测收敛阶与理论阶偏差 ≤0.2，基准量误差 <3%。

gaps.need: Riemann 通量（Roe/HLLC/AUSM+/Godunov）与高阶重构（MUSCL/minmod-vanLeer、WENO5）需作为可插拔、可单测的组件；现状为黑箱或单一格式。
gaps.proposal: 抽 flux/ 与 reconstruction/ 为纯函数（无全局状态），每个通量配一致性与对称性单测（F(U,U)=物理通量、旋转不变性、熵条件），再用 GAP-FVM-001 算例测精度阶。
gaps.acceptance: ≥4 通量 × ≥3 重构组合可插拔，单测全绿，WENO5 实测阶 ≥4.5。

gaps.need: FV 与 DG 块的守恒界面（mortar/数值通量匹配、阶跃处精度不退化）在开源中主要由 SU2 的FV+DG 双路径与 PyFR/ExaDG/HORSES3D 的纯 DG 各自覆盖，缺可复用混合界面实现。
gaps.proposal: 先做 1D 两区块（左 FV 右 DG-p）守恒性单测：界面通量单一取值、总质量/动量守恒到机器精度；再做 2D 平板边界层混合网格验证。
gaps.acceptance: 界面通量唯一性单测通过，跨界面守恒误差 <1e-12（相对），算例与纯 FV 解差 <3%。

gaps.need: 块结构 AMR（Berger-Colella 嵌套 + 通量回插 + 荷载均衡）与 GPU offload 路径缺失，现有实现限于单层均匀网格/单卡。
gaps.proposal: 参照 AMReX 的分层数据结构实现两级 patch AMR 最小闭环（细化判据→通量回插→守恒检查），并在集群 loong64 双节点上测 weak/strong scaling（32→128 核）。
gaps.acceptance: 两级 AMR 质量/动量守恒误差 <1e-10，128 核并行效率 ≥70%（对照 32 核基线）。

gaps.need: FV 内核需对设计变量可导（Riemann 通量与限幅器的自定义 VJP/隐函数微分），开源已有 JAX 栈（jax-cfd/PhiFlow/JAX-FLUIDS/AeroJAX）与 Enzyme 路线（WaterLily）可对标。
gaps.proposal: 以 1D Sod 与 2D 圆柱绕流为目标，实现（a）有限差分梯度 vs （b）离散伴随/AD 梯度的一致性测试：方向导数相对误差 <1e-6；再与 DAFoam 类伴随结果做交叉核对。
gaps.acceptance: AD 与有限差分梯度相对误差 <1e-6（≥5 个方向），端到端反演 10 步内收敛。

gaps.need: 用例/网格/边界条件的声明式配置与 Python 驱动层（case 管理、场 I/O、批量参数扫描）缺失，导致基准回归与战役化批量计算难自动化。
gaps.proposal: 实现 config→case 生成器（YAML schema + 校验）与结果落盘规范（provenance: 输入/版本/网格哈希），对齐本平台证据纪律（零手抄、数字 SQL/文件溯源）。
gaps.acceptance: 1 份 YAML 生成可跑算例 + provenance 完整字段覆盖 100%，同一 case 二次运行结果位级可复现。

gaps.need: VOF/level-set 界面（表面张力、界面锐化）在多相溃坝/气泡上缺验证面；开源 aphros/OpenFOAM interFoam 提供对照基线。
gaps.proposal: 引入 Martin-Moyce 2D 溃坝（含/不含障碍）与静水压平衡算例，判据：前沿位置相对误差、界面锐化度、质量守恒。
gaps.acceptance: 溃坝前沿位置与基准实验相对误差 <15%（工程可接受线），质量守恒误差 <1e-8。

gaps.need: 伴随/形状优化闭环（目标函数→梯度→几何更新）无端到端示例，无法证明可微化路线在工程目标上
gaps.proposal: 以 2D 翼型/船体剖面阻力最小化为目标，串起 "求解→梯度→参数更新" 闭环，与有限差分核对。
gaps.acceptance: 目标函数单调下降 ≥80% 迭代，梯度与有限差分相对误差 <1e-4。

gaps.need: GPU 后端（CUDA/HIP/SYCL）与统一的 kernel 抽象缺失；PyFR 后端插件式设计、Oceananigans 的同码跨 CPU/GPU 是两条可借鉴路线。
gaps.proposal: 先做单卡 kernel 移植（通量+重构热点），用 roofline 分析确定瓶颈，再决定是否引入后端抽象层。
gaps.acceptance: 单卡热点 kernel 相对 CPU 单核加速 ≥10×，结果与 CPU 版相对误差 <1e-10。
